🍽

Feastmark

Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube in one tap — even when the recipe is only spoken in the video. Your kitchen, organized.

Coming soon to the App Store
Features

Everything your recipe collection needs

Share a video or post from any app and Feastmark extracts the recipe automatically — ingredients, instructions, and all.

⚡️

Save in One Tap

Share any recipe video or post to Feastmark. We extract the full recipe automatically — even when it's only spoken in the video.

👨‍🍳

Cook Mode

The step you're on fills the screen in big type. Ingredients stay one tap away in a sheet, still checked off where you left them, and the screen never sleeps mid-recipe.

📓

Cook Log

Cook it again, better. Rate what you made, add a photo, and note what you'd change — that note is the first thing waiting for you the next time you open the recipe.

⏱

Step Timers

Cook Mode reads the time out of the step — "simmer for 20 minutes" — and offers it as a one-tap countdown. No time in the text? Start one yourself.

✏️

Make It Yours

Edit any recipe, add personal notes, or write one from scratch with your own photo. Your cookbook, your rules.

📚

Collections

Organize recipes into collections like "Weeknight Dinners" or "Date Night." Filter your library in seconds.

⚖️

Ingredient Scaling

Cooking for two or twelve? Adjust serving size and every ingredient scales automatically.

🍸

Drinks, Too

Save a cocktail and Feastmark says Make, not Cook — and keeps a Pour Log in place of the Cook Log.

📎

Add from Anywhere

No share sheet handy? Paste a link right in the app. Can't extract it? Save it as a draft and finish it later.

🔍

Search Everything

Search by name, tag, or ingredient — "what can I make with chicken?" — and find exactly what you're craving.

🔒

Private by Design

Your recipes stay on your device. No account required, no data sold. Ever.

Works with your favorite apps

Share from wherever you find recipes

📸 Instagram
🎵 TikTok
▶️ YouTube
🌐 Recipe blogs
